Create a schedule

Usage:
  kaab schedules create (--program REF --cron EXPR | --file BODY.json) [flags]

Flags:
      --change-detection     emit schedule.changed when the data changes
      --cron string          five-field cron
      --field stringArray    with --change-detection: a field path to compare (repeatable)
      --file string          a JSON body (POST /schedules); flags override it
  -h, --help                 help for create
      --input stringArray    a program input, name=value (repeatable)
      --program string       the program reference (name@alias follows the alias)
      --timezone string      IANA time zone (UTC by default)
      --webhook-url string   where the runs' events go

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
